name: wsl-proxy-formal
description: Quint models of the WSL proxy transport

scripts.typecheck: npm run quint -- typecheck transport/transport.qnt && npm run quint -- typecheck transport/scenarios.qnt && npm run quint -- typecheck transport/no_idle.qnt
scripts.test: npm run quint -- test transport/scenarios.qnt --backend typescript --seed 20261120
scripts.simulate: npm run quint -- run transport/scenarios.qnt --backend typescript --invariant safety --max-samples 1000 --max-steps 100 --seed 20261120 --verbosity 1
scripts.verify: npm run quint -- verify transport/transport.qnt --backend tlc --apalache-version 0.62.4 --invariant safety --temporal fair_no_linger,no_reopen --tlc-config tlc.json --verbosity 3
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run simulate && npm run verify && npm run counterexamples
